definitions.gloss: small number of people, small group
definitions.explanation: Refers to a small group or a limited number of participants. Commonly used in educational and business contexts to describe small-group settings.

examples.japanese: {少人数|しょうにんずう}のクラスで{学|まな}ぶ。
{少人数|しょうにんずう}{制|せい}の{授業|じゅぎょう}は{質問|しつもん}しやすい。
examples.english: It's easier to ask questions in small-group lessons.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{研修|けんしゅう}は{少人数|しょうにんずう}で{行|おこな}うため、{一人一人|ひとりひとり}に{目|め}が{届|とど}く。
examples.english: This training session will be conducted with a small group, so each person will receive individual attention.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a modifier: {少人数|しょうにんずう}の～ or {少人数|しょうにんずう}～. The opposite is {大人数|おおにんずう} (large number of people). Very common in education ({少人数|しょうにんずう}{教育|きょういく}, small-group education) and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {少人数|しょうにんずう}{制|せい}: small-group system
- {少人数|しょうにんずう}{教育|きょういく}: small-group education
- {少人数|しょうにんずう}クラス: small class
- {少人数|しょうにんずう}で{行|おこな}う: conduct with a small group
